bills.summary: Proof of citizenship required for all 13M+ registered Florida voters — mirrors SAVE Act. Also removes student IDs as valid voter ID.
bills.status: Passed legislature (Senate 27-12, House 77-28, Mar 12-13) · Awaiting Gov. DeSantis signature

bills.summary: State officials can designate nonprofits as 'domestic terrorist organizations' — no criminal conviction required. Bars state funding, criminalizes membership, expels public university students from designated orgs.
bills.status: Passed legislature (Senate 25-11, House 80-25, Mar 12-13) · Awaiting Gov. DeSantis signature

bills.summary: Eliminates countywide early voting — Fulton loses 43 sites, DeKalb loses 19. Assigns all voters to a single designated precinct. Mandates hand-marked paper ballots for November 2026 general only. Same sponsor is calling for Fulton County state takeover.
bills.status: DEAD — Failed Senate floor vote 27-21 (Mar 6) · Watch for language in HB 397 before Apr 2 sine die

bills.summary: Virginia joins the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact — awards VA's electoral votes to the national popular vote winner when enough states join.
bills.status: Passed both chambers · Sent to Gov. Spanberger (Feb 25)

bills.summary: Proof of citizenship required for state elections only — creates two-tier voting system. Federal elections exempt. Kansas used same bifurcated approach: 31,000 voters blocked.
bills.status: Passed legislature · Gov. Cox has until Mar 26 to sign or veto · ACLU filed veto letter

bills.summary: Removes student IDs as valid voter identification — disproportionately affects college-town voters.
bills.status: Passed both chambers (House 190-148, Senate 16-8, Mar 5) · Awaiting Gov. Ayotte signature

bills.summary: Mandates citizenship verification through the federal SAVE database for all voter registrations — mirrors the SAVE Act model at the state level.
Deploying federal troops or military personnel at New Mexico polling places is a fourth-degree felony. Also bars any attempt to alter voter qualifications beyond state law.

Kills the Active Early Voter List used by 80%+ of Arizona voters. Requires mail ballot re-request before every election. Also embeds language in the AZ constitution enabling future elimination of mail voting entirely.
bills.status: Passed Senate 17-13 · Engrossed in House · Goes directly to Nov 2026 ballot if legislature approves

bills.summary: Creates a state-law right to sue federal officers (ICE, CBP, any federal agent) for constitutional violations in New York state courts. Directly fills the gap left by decades of Supreme Court rulings limiting Bivens claims.
bills.status: In Senate Codes Committee · Gov. Hochul endorsing · Moving via state budget (spring)

bills.summary: Puts winner-take-all electoral college allocation on the November 2026 ballot — would eliminate the Omaha 'blue dot' district vote that has split Nebraska's electoral votes in 2008, 2020, and 2024.
bills.status: Carryover from 2025 · Prioritized by Gov. Pillen · Floor vote pending
